verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an LLM observability and evaluation platform like Weave, but the evidence pack never documents deploying the Weave product on your own infrastructure. The only "self-hosted" mentions refer to tracking costs for users' own self-hosted models, which is a different capability. A server release-notes URL alone does not show that customers can run the product themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
